full_judgment: 3. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record appearing for the petitioner, submits that there was no evidence of dishonest intention to deceive, the conviction under section 406 of the Penal Code was unwarranted and as such the sentence has been illegally passed.
